name: Anonymous whole-plot viewer and four independent plots
description: Verify all four published plots load independently without sign-in, including อุทยานแห่งชาติ ชุมพร.
steps: Open the app in a fresh browser context without credentials and wait for the first ZIP download and 3D forest to render.
Verify the Thai read-only banner and the whole-plot mode are visible.
Select chompon_green_012 in #plot-select and verify #tree-count is 382 and the heading identifies Chumphon high-density green.
Select kb_red_015, wait for its download, and verify 12 candidates and Krabi low-density red.
Select chumpon_yellow_011, wait for its download, and verify 251 candidates and Chumphon medium-density yellow.
Select dnp_chumpon_014 in #plot-select, wait for its download, verify the name อุทยานแห่งชาติ ชุมพร and 1,136 candidates. Colour and density remain unspecified.
Check that a full-height 3D forest is visible in each plot and no sign-in screen or local-server requirement appears.
expected: All four snapshots load anonymously with correct metadata/counts and independent rendered forests.

name: Read a tree circle and download the sanitized inventory
description: Inspect a published stem cross-section and download its public CSV without editing any measurement.
steps: Open the app and select chompon_green_012; wait for data to load.
Enter T00002 in #tree-search and click the matching tree item.
Verify the tree-view mode, diameter/circumference/height metrics, slice points, and gold fitted circle.
Click #focus-measurement to inspect the circle at a useful scale.
Open the export menu and choose CSV; confirm the download succeeds and includes the selected plot ID.
Verify #save-button and #preview-button do not exist and the right panel says the published measurement is read-only.
expected: The published tree geometry and metrics are readable, a sanitized CSV downloads, and no edit/save controls are exposed.

name: POM remains separate and invalid searches are safe
description: Verify an actual POM-review candidate is never represented as confirmed DBH and that a missing tree search has a clear empty state.
steps: Open the app and select chompon_green_012.
Search for T00004 and select the actual POM_REVIEW candidate.
Verify the type or status indicates POM review and the confirmed DBH metric remains unconfirmed rather than being replaced with POM diameter.
Verify there is no measurement form, reviewer field, refit button, or save button.
Search for NO_SUCH_TREE_987 and verify the list shows its no-match message without showing a different tree as a match.
Clear the search and verify the original tree list returns.
expected: POM and DBH are clearly distinct, unconfirmed DBH stays unconfirmed, no mutation controls exist, and the negative search recovers cleanly.

name: Mobile plot controls remain usable
description: Use the public Krabi snapshot and its visualization controls on a mobile viewport.
steps: Open the app at a mobile viewport and select kb_red_015.
Wait for the forest and 12-candidate list, then verify the page has no horizontal overflow.
Scroll to visualization controls; change #cloud-background to dark and back to mid.
Change #point-size and verify its displayed pixel size updates.
Use #understory-view when enabled and verify the cut is labeled as approximate terrain-relative visual clipping, not a DBH measurement.
Use #reset-view to restore full plot extent and full height.
expected: Mobile navigation and visualization controls are readable and usable, and visual clipping never masquerades as a measurement edit.

name: Detail LOD and tree/plot transitions stay isolated
description: Load nearby detail and switch view modes and plots without mixing geometry from different snapshots.
steps: Open the app and select chumpon_yellow_011.
Zoom or pan into an area and click #load-detail; wait for detail to complete and verify the point-count footer reports overview plus detail.
Select a yellow-plot tree from the list and verify its ID begins chumpon_yellow_011.
Click #whole-plot-button and verify the yellow forest returns.
Switch to kb_red_015 and verify the old yellow geometry clears while loading and the final candidate list contains only kb_red_015 IDs.
Choose a Krabi tree, then return to whole-plot mode and verify both the forest and plot metadata remain Krabi.
Switch to dnp_chumpon_014; select dnp_chumpon_014_T00001. Verify diameter about 13.55 cm, circle circumference about 42.57 cm and unconfirmed DBH, with no edit or save controls.
Download its CSV and verify the DNP plot ID; return to whole plot and then another plot to confirm isolation.
expected: Detail and view transitions work without stale cross-plot geometry or incorrect tree IDs.
